$comment: Blanc coverage manifest, read by tools/blanc-drift.cjs.
Every member of DesktopWinSection (src/shared/desktop.ts) must appear here.
'covered' must name a real BLANC_TOOL_IDS entry (blancToolId) or a Blanc tab
surface (blancSurface). A tab-routed bail-out to a Study OS tab is NOT
coverage, and neither is a render branch that mounts a Study OS *View —
both are Pillar 0 violations and stay 'pending' until rebuilt Blanc-native.

library.note: Blanc's Read tab is a native panel, not an embed.

note.note: Blanc's quick-notes is deliberately local and separate from Notebook.

musicwidget.note: Taskbar widget; the full music library is tracked under 'music'.

settings.reason: Blanc has its own settings panel with its own schema (toolboxSettings). Mirroring Study OS settings would be two editors over different stores.

city.reason: City is its own desktop with its own engine and simulation loop. Pulling it into Blanc would defeat Pillar 1 outright.

flashcards.note: Rebuilt Blanc-native 2026-07-21; composes FlashcardsContent (review/mining/csv/ai/overview). AI Studio hidden in Blanc.

player.note: Rebuilt Blanc-native 2026-07-21; composes MediaContent in 'full' mode.

video.note: Same Blanc-native panel as 'player'; MediaContent keeps the 'video' mode for Study OS.

novels.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-07-21 (Stream B); composes NovelsContent (useNovels + filters/table/inspector). NovelsView is 1004 → 119 lines. Verified live: 208 titles, three-pane jiten-workbench, 0 .ui-app-chrome.

notebook.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-07-20; composes NotebookContent. quick-notes stays a separate local scratchpad, per plan.

games.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-07-21 (Stream B); composes GameArenaContent's GameArena, shared verbatim with Study OS. GameArenaView is 1053 → 8 lines. Verified live: arena renders 13 game entries with XP/streak/badges, 0 .ui-app-chrome.

visualizer.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-07-21 (Stream B); composes VisualizerContent (useVisualizer + VizStage) over the shared audioBus — no second audio graph. Verified live: canvas stage plus Style/React-to/Colors controls, 0 .ui-app-chrome.

music.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-07-20; composes MusicContent. Shares playerBus with the FocusMusicBar widget.

scraper.note: Pillar 2. ScraperApp is an app of its own (own AppChrome, rail, status bar, 17 pages, mock port) — Blanc will not mirror the acquisition shell. The study-relevant slice is the Discover catalogue console (components/discover/DiscoverContent.tsx), which is already extracted hook-plus-blocks precisely so Blanc can compose it. Port that as a Blanc 'discover' tool.

immersion.note: Ported Blanc-native 2026-07-21 (Stream B); composes ImmersionContent (useImmersion + toolbar/stage/rail/popups). ImmersionView is 1027 → 330 lines. The read-only 'immersion-tracker' tool stays alongside it. Verified live: toolbar, sites rail, reader mode, and Live mode mounting a real <webview> guest in the Blanc window — 0 .ui-app-chrome.

agent.note: Classified 2026-09-06, after tools/blanc-drift.cjs stopped reading 0 sections. NOT covered, and the near-miss is why this entry exists: Blanc ships a real Blanc-native 'local-agent' tool (LocalAgentPanel, BlancReadyToolPanels.tsx:320) with objectives, a task queue, automations, profiles and model selection — so a coverage claim would look plausible and would be false. AppSection.tsx:72 renders <AgentWorkspaceShell />, which is the CENTRAL agent (main-v1 Track 3): provider targeting local/remote, allowLocalFallback, a pricing table, input/output budgets, a plan queue and confirmation gating. LocalAgentPanel has none of those; it is the local-runtime half. The gap to port is the provider/execution seam, not the runtime panel — reuse the local-agent panel and add target + budget + plan-queue blocks beside it.

files.note: Classified 2026-09-06. New Study OS section (AppSection.tsx:141) that landed with the files-app track and was invisible while the drift parser read 0 sections. Blanc's 'file-search' tool is NOT coverage and must not be recorded as such: it is a filename search over a folder the user picks with toolboxPickSearchFolder, i.e. a DISK browser, and FILES_APP_PLAN.md's Decision 2 is the opposite — the tree is what the app owns, over heterogeneous stores (SQLite rows, localStorage, main JSON, derived state), never real directories. Note also that the Files app ABSORBED the Notebook section, which this manifest still carries as covered under 'notebook' — that entry is now stale, since 'notebook' is no longer in DESKTOP_WIN_SECTIONS, and the drift tool cannot see it because it only iterates live sections.
